source_text: Misit Dominus virum prophetam: Ego vos eduxi de Aegypto. Ingratitudo redarguitur. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Sent Lord man prophet: I you led-out from Egypt. Ingratitude is-rebuked. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord sent a prophet: I brought you up from Egypt >> Bible:Judges 6:8-10]]. Ingratitude is rebuked. Amen.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
